standard_prerequisites.use: The etale-local nature of the Gorenstein property on algebraic spaces, the pointwise ring criterion (lemma-gorenstein, same chapter), and the flat-under-Gorenstein lemma of Dualizing Complexes; cited inputs, with the exhibited homomorphism written out in the retained span.

core_obligations: Work etale locally so the Gorenstein conditions on the algebraic spaces can be read on Noetherian local rings, citing the scheme version, or alternatively invoke the stated equivalence of conditions (a) and (b) for the Gorenstein property at a point.
Exhibit the local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings from the quotient of the strict local ring at y by the closure of z to the corresponding quotient at x.
Identify the fibre of this homomorphism as the corresponding quotient at x by the closure of y.
Apply the flat-under-Gorenstein lemma from dualizing complexes to conclude all four parts, including descent of the Gorenstein property along f when it is flat.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce etale locally to the scheme case and invoke the ring criterion for the Gorenstein property at a point.
Exhibit the local homomorphism of quotient strict local rings, identify its fibre, and apply the flat-under-Gorenstein lemma.

difficulty_reason: For morphisms of algebraic spaces with locally Noetherian fibres, the four statements say that the Gorenstein property composes and descends along flat morphisms, pointwise and globally. The retained proof first reduces etale locally to the scheme case and then gives an explicit ring route: using the stated equivalence between the Gorenstein property and a condition on strict local rings, it exhibits the concrete local homomorphism of the quotient rings, identifies its fibre, and applies the flat-under-Gorenstein lemma of dualizing complexes. The exhibited homomorphism and the identification of its fibre are the written reduction steps. Retained author proof at lines 6630-6651.
